name: Pull request page
tagline: Description, activity, checks and merge box
summary: A repository's pull request list and the page for one pull request: description, activity, reviewers, checks, and a merge box that can merge, update the branch or re-run CI.

flow.label: PR page route
flow.note: Starts the page query without blocking navigation; the title comes from data already in the cache.

flow.label: PullDetailContent
flow.note: Paints header, body, activity and sidebar from cache, or skeletons built from sample data.

flow.label: getPullPageData
flow.note: One GraphQL query for the PR, commits and first and last comments, with timeline events in parallel.

flow.label: GitHub GraphQL and REST
flow.note: Returns the PR, up to 100 commits, the first and last 30 comments and the first 100 timeline events.

flow.label: Merge box
flow.note: Loads reviews, checks and branch state; polls every 10 s while checks run, then backs off and stops.

flow.label: mergePullRequest
flow.note: Merges with the chosen method and commit message; the page and open lists then refresh.

features.name: Repository PR list
features.summary: Filterable list, 30 per page; line counts for the whole page come from one aliased GraphQL query, and rows can be selected to merge, close or reopen in bulk.

features.name: One-call page load
features.summary: Detail, commits, the first and last comment pages and timeline events arrive together; middle comment pages load when the reader asks for them.

features.name: Merge box
features.summary: Reviews, checks and conflict or out-of-date state in one card, then merge, squash or rebase with an editable commit message. Drafts get Ready for review.

features.name: Checks and re-runs
features.summary: Check runs, commit statuses and required checks not yet reported in one grouped list. Re-run all or failed only, and approve workflows that wait for approval.

features.name: Bypass branch protections
features.summary: A bypass checkbox appears only when merging is blocked, there are no conflicts, and rulesets or classic branch protection say this viewer may bypass.

features.name: Reviewers picker
features.summary: Request or remove people, teams and known review bots (Copilot, CodeRabbit, Cursor and others). The sidebar updates at once; number keys pick the first nine.

features.name: Stacked pull requests
features.summary: Stacks are worked out from branch names alone (B targets A's head branch). The list groups them and the merge box shows where this PR sits in its stack.
